suite: RoomService + real Simulation / FakeIO transport unit tests ONLY

results.name: Creates independent resume sessions without exposing tokens in room list
Room creation assigns Player 1 and host
An invalid room code cannot join
Second player joins same room with Player 2 identity
Online duplicate country selection is allowed
Room capacity is enforced at two players
Start without two ready players is refused; guest cannot start or change rules
Settings validated; changes reset both ready states
Both ready players start a shared server-owned simulation
Room rules and chosen country lock during running match
Each player builds only inside their own map using the same authoritative rules
Duplicate command IDs return cached acknowledgement without executing twice
Forged damage, resources, owner and invalid numeric payloads are refused
Ownership validation rejects opposing factory production/cancellation
Player 2 factory genuinely delivers a missile on server ticks
Invalid or insufficient ammunition cannot create a missile
Valid Player 2 launch consumes own stock and creates one authoritative missile
Snapshots never leak enemy stock, resources, research or unseen structures
Satellite observations are delivered as knowledge, not hidden authoritative fields
Hidden launch events are filtered out without radar coverage
Detected enemy missile sends only public track, not target or origin coordinates
Online intelligence cannot be toggled by one client mid-game
Public-info match snapshot retains enemy entities without their production queues
Disconnect pauses the entire match and informs the connected opponent
Authoritative time does not advance while opponent is disconnected
Valid resume token restores same Player 2 nation, stock and IDs
Concurrent reuse of a live session token is rejected
Returning player can request a full explicit resync
Command ack cache survives reconnect to prevent repeated purchases
Malformed payload is caught at event boundary without stopping server
Per-session rate budget bounds abusive event bursts
Disconnect grace expiration closes room and frees simulation references
Host transfer works for waiting-room departure
Leaving an empty waiting room deletes it
Idle disconnected sessions are eventually removed
